statement: For the reviewed Logitech DJ consumer, a paired report 0x41 schedules child HID creation, an unpaired report 0x40 schedules destruction, and connection-status report 0x42 on link loss forwards a neutral input report instead of deleting that child. Re-pairing after unpairing creates a new HID object, while ordinary link loss preserves its existing child node.

applicability.scope: Logitech DJ link-loss, unpair and re-pair distinctions; no physical pairing run
